Prop trader T-X1005-04 bought 1132 at market (13:20:37), then placed three one-sided BUY limits of 4077 each (12231 total, 5.04x depth, 4-6 ticks behind the touch) at 13:20:39-43. At 13:20:57 it sold 1132 at market, with fills falling from 9999 to 9994. About 600 ms later all three bids were cancelled in full, with no fills on them. There was no market-making registration, no event, no risk event and no pegged parents. The tape shows no favourable price move, no reversion and a negative round trip, so feature (b) is weak. A stop-out reading is possible. It does not explain why 12231 of one-sided bids sat there unexecuted and were pulled right after the sale, so feature (a) is not excluded. Mixed evidence, so I propose escalation to Level 2. This is not a STOR draft: there is no repetition and no clear benefit.
